Variable

Concept

  • Variables in the SJS code are references of values.
  • If a variable is not declared but assigned a value, it is defined as a global variable.
  • If a variable is declared but no value is assigned, the default value is undefined.
  • If the performance of var is the same as that of JavaScript, variables are improved.
var foo = 1;
var bar = "hello world";
var i; // i === undefined

Variable Name

Variable names must comply with the following rules:

  • The first character must be a letter (a-z, A-Z), underscore (\ _).
  • The remaining characters can be letters (a-zA-Z), underscores (\ _), and digits (0-9).

Reserved Identifiers

Complying with the JavaScript syntax rules, the following identifiers cannot be used as variable names:

delete
void
typeof

null
undefined
NaN
Infinity
var

if
else

true
false

require

this
function
arguments
return

for
while
do
break
continue
switch
case
default
